messages:
maria: FYI - HelioWear (customer_id=heliowear) invoice inv_2026_1122 failed at charge time. Gateway decline says 'card_blocked_by_issuer' and acquirer tag shows velocity rule. Card last4=9876, bin_country=CA, billing_country=US. Amount ~$7,450. Can ops/recon look into fallback options?
payments-bot: alert: payment_attempt_failed invoice=inv_2026_1122 gateway=stripe-ca reason=issuer_velocity_block attempt=1
jon: I'll check acquirer risk flags and see if this is temporary velocity. Hypothesis: issuer flagged repeated cross-border charges this billing cycle.
nora: Finance note: we're comfortable approving wire fallback for orders >= $7k if KYC attached and sales signs off. Otherwise keep retrying card up to 2 manual attempts.
maria: Support please pause automated dunning emails and ask customer if they can use hosted-pay link or submit wire. Sales outreach helps retention.
nashley: Created ticket S-10110 and messaged customer with hosted pay link and wire option: https://zendesk.redwood/s/10110. Hosted-pay link: https://pay.redwood/hosted/heliowear/inv_2026_1122
oliver: Sales chiming in - HelioWear prefers same-day resolution. I'll call them now; if they agree to wire, ask for beneficiary name + swift/BIC + IBAN.
jon: Ops playbook: first escalate to acquirer to request a one-time bypass for velocity (call AcquirerOps). If acquirer can approve, ops can run a manual auth with flags: `bypass_risk=true`. Manual auth cmd below.
jon: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/manual-auth \ 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_1122","card_last4":"9876","metadata":{"note":"acquirer_bypass_requested"}}' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
```
nora: If manual auth fails or acquirer won't bypass, finance will fast-track wire once sales provides KYC + PR. Use vendor form: https://internal.redwood/finance/wires and cc finance@redwood. We need copy of company reg + proof of funds if >$5k (per recent policy).
maria: For reconciliation mark invoice.status = 'awaiting_payment_method' and add note: 'issuer velocity - awaiting customer choice'. Do not recognize revenue until settled.
ashley: Customer replied preferring hosted-pay. I sent the hosted-pay link and suggested trying from mobile to avoid issuer friction. Ticket updated.
oliver: On call: customer says they can pay via hosted-pay within 30 mins. If that fails, they will do wire. I'm on standby.
maria: Great. Action items: (1) Ops ping AcquirerOps (jon), (2) Support monitor hosted-pay and assist customer if 3DS/issuer issues pop, (3) Finance prepare wire PR if needed (nora), (4) Sales follow-up on call (oliver). Back in 2 hours for status. :thumbsup:
